source: User answer in this coordinator chat to the explicit new ILX navigation policy question
question: Should ILX::notify retain a conditional source link to the original ILX::init extension after an earlier opaque ILX::call?

ilx_navigation_after_opaque_calls.meaning: Do not preserve ILX source-navigation associations across earlier opaque calls. A later handle read cannot reuse the earlier association to navigate to the extension after that barrier.
ilx_navigation_after_opaque_calls.scope: ILX read-only source navigation; does not reopen other recorded policies or general after-load analysis decisions.
implementation_constraints: Withdraw the ILX association at opaque earlier operations/calls; do not add the proposed repeated conditional remote association ledger.

Any first-operand association still needs its genuine constructor/setter/source-read owners and all existing currentness/refusal guards. This decision grants no Native handle, definite current cell, quiet effect or Normal completion.

Correct only test expectations that require navigation after the opaque barrier, citing this decision; retain exact first-site positives, supported same-frame behavior and stale/foreign/dynamic/reassignment/observer refusal assertions.
